meta_title: MJS Decorating Services | Painter & Decorator Bristol
meta_description: MJS Decorating Services in Bristol offers interior and exterior painting, decorating, and wallpapering. Professional finishes, free quotes. Call 07970 866652.
hero_subhead: From interior redecorating to full exterior paint jobs, we deliver professional finishes that last. Get your free quote today.
services_subhead: Whether it's a single bedroom refresh or a full property renovation, we handle interior and exterior work with precision.

services.title: Interior Painting & Decorating
services.desc: Walls, ceilings, woodwork, and feature walls. We prep thoroughly, use quality paints, and leave your rooms fresh and bright.

services.title: Exterior Painting
services.desc: Weather-resistant finishes for fascias, soffits, doors, and siding. Protects your home and improves kerb appeal.

services.title: Wallpapering & Hanging
services.desc: Pattern-matched hanging and removal of old paper. We work with trendy designs, textured finishes, and traditional styles.

services.title: Artexing & Ceiling Work
services.desc: Repair, restoration, and finishing of textured ceilings. We can match existing patterns or smooth for a modern look.

services.title: Wood Staining & Varnishing
services.desc: Bring out the natural beauty of timber doors, floors, and furniture. Long-lasting, durable finishes inside or out.

services.title: Commercial Decorating
services.desc: Quick turnaround for offices, shops, and rental properties. Minimal disruption, professional standards, and flexible scheduling.

about_pullquote: We don't rush a job — every room deserves attention to detail and quality paint.
about_para_1: MJS Decorating Services has been transforming Bristol homes and businesses for over 15 years. Founded on the principle that good decorating shouldn't be rushed or overpriced, we've built a reputation for reliable, skilled work and honest dealing. Our team covers Yate, Bristol, and the surrounding areas, handling everything from small domestic projects to large commercial contracts.
about_para_2: Customers return to us because we listen, we turn up on time, and we leave your space looking better than you imagined. We take pride in surface preparation — the unglamorous bit that makes the difference between a paint job that looks good for two years and one that lasts a decade. That's why repeat business and word-of-mouth referrals make up the majority of our work.
reviews_heading: What Bristol Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Absolutely brilliant job on our lounge. Mark came and gave us a realistic quote, turned up when he said he would, and the whole place looks immaculate. He's tidy, professional, and didn't leave us with a mess to clear up. Can't fault him. Will be booking him again for the bedrooms.
reviews.author: David T.

reviews.text: Had the exterior of our Victorian terrace painted. The team was respectful, careful with neighbouring gardens, and the prep work was thorough. Paint's holding up beautifully even in the rain. Reasonable price too. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Jennifer M.

reviews.text: Called for a wallpapering job at short notice. Mark fitted us in quickly, matched the pattern perfectly, and cleared everything away. The room looks brand new. Professional, friendly, and worth every penny. Already booked him for the hallway.
reviews.author: Robert K.
